The problem

Read the transcript

You're drowning in design requests, and there's no time to do them all. So the spring flyer waits, and Tuesday's quote never goes out. Then your biggest client gets a report with the old logo, and you look unprofessional.

So you start from a designer-made template, in your own logo, colours, and fonts. Your first one's ready to send in under five minutes. After that, anyone on your team can make the next flyer from the same design.

Got a spreadsheet of leads? Every one gets a quote with their name on it. Your app can make the invoice the moment a job's done. And your AI agent makes ten ads to test, each with the right logo.

Create your first design, free, at thirds.ai!

Questions people ask before they start

Create your first design

What is PDF automation?

PDF automation means you make the same kind of PDF again and again without building each one by hand. In thirds.ai you save a design once. Then you fill in the new name and price, or your AI assistant or your own code does, and you get a finished PDF or image each time.

Can I try thirds.ai without an account?

Yes. Change the words on the sample ad on this page and download it, or open the playground to try more designs.

Is thirds.ai free?

Yes, to start. The Free plan gives you 50 credits every month, and you can spend them on the AI chat too. Pick a paid plan when you need more.

Is thirds.ai an AI image generator?

No. An image generator draws a new picture each time, so fonts and colours drift and words come out wrong. thirds.ai fills a design that you can edit, with layers like a design file, so every file looks like your brand and the words come out right. The editor can also make a picture to place inside a design.

What can I change in a template?

Everything on it, from the words and pictures to the colours and layout. Once it's saved, every new file keeps that look.

Can ChatGPT or Claude make files from my design?

Yes. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or another AI tool through the MCP server, and ask for files in plain words. From your own code, call the REST API in any language.

How much does a finished file cost?

Each finished PDF or image costs 1 credit. If a file fails on our side, you don't pay for it.

Questions people ask before they start

Create your first design

What is PDF automation?

PDF automation means you make the same kind of PDF again and again without building each one by hand. In thirds.ai you save a design once. Then you fill in the new name and price, or your AI assistant or your own code does, and you get a finished PDF or image each time.

Can I try thirds.ai without an account?

是的。 Change the words on the sample ad on this page and download it, or open the playground to try more designs.

Is thirds.ai free?

Yes, to start. The Free plan gives you 50 credits every month, and you can spend them on the AI chat too. Pick a paid plan when you need more.

Is thirds.ai an AI image generator?

No. An image generator draws a new picture each time, so fonts and colours drift and words come out wrong. thirds.ai fills a design that you can edit, with layers like a design file, so every file looks like your brand and the words come out right. The editor can also make a picture to place inside a design.

What can I change in a template?

Everything on it, from the words and pictures to the colours and layout. Once it's saved, every new file keeps that look.

Can ChatGPT or Claude make files from my design?

是的。 Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or another AI tool through the MCP server, and ask for files in plain words. From your own code, call the REST API in any language.

How much does a finished file cost?

Each finished PDF or image costs 1 credit. If a file fails on our side, you don't pay for it.
